title: Beta skills
summary: Fuelled by the Beta gauge (Perfect Parries and combo finishers); good at breaking shields and balance.

sections.note: SP comes from first clears. A skill can be learned once the skill it requires is learned.
rows: Continuously generates Arcs to attack furiously.
Recovers some Beta Energy when an enemy is hit with Triplet.
Triplet

Generates an additional arc, landing the final blow.
Tap the Beta icon after using Triplet to use the skill.
Beta Energy Withdrawal
Damages the Balance of the enemy hit with Quadruplet. Increases the Attack Power of Quadruplet.
Quadruplet
Unleashes two waves of fatal energy.
Recovers some Beta Energy when an enemy is hit with Shock Wave.
Shock Wave

Fires additional energy waves, landing the final blow.
Tap the Beta icon after using Shockwave to use the skill.
Beta Energy Withdrawal
Increases the Attack Power of Shock Wave.
Cross Wave
Launches an energy blade forward.
Recovers some Beta Energy when an enemy is hit with Slash.
Slash

Swings the energy blade again, landing the final blow.
Tap the Beta icon after using Slash to use the skill.
Beta Energy Withdrawal
Slash deals additional Damage to enemy Shields.
Crescent Slash
Delivers a sudden strike to enemies and deals high Damage to their shield.
Shield Breaker deals additional Damage to enemy Shields.
Shield Breaker

Delivers consecutive strikes to the enemy if Shield Breaker is used.
Tap the Beta icon after using Shield Breaker to use the skill.
Shield Damage Boost
